title: TF1766 1.766 Hz frequency and Spiral Flow time mapping
description: Model record for the proposed TF1766 ↔ 1.766 Hz mapping. The frequency is evaluated with established frequency relations; the inverse-frequency cosmic-time coordinate is a Spiral Flow model transformation.
definitions: Physical period is T = 1/f and is not the Spiral Flow cosmic-time coordinate.
The Spiral Flow time coordinate is defined here as t(f) = t_ref × f_ref / f with f_ref = 0.1 Hz and t_ref = 10.8 Gyr.
The TF1766 ↔ 1.766 Hz identification is a model input and is not asserted here as an established physical law.
assumptions: SI frequency is measured in Hertz.
Planck–Einstein E = hf applies to the energy quantum being evaluated.
m = E/c² is interpreted as an energy-equivalent inertial mass, not photon rest mass.
The Spiral Flow time relation is a declared model transformation, not an established cosmological law.
mechanism: The established frequency relations compute period, angular frequency, energy and energy-equivalent mass. The Spiral Flow coordinate is a separate inverse-frequency transform using the declared reference pair (0.1 Hz, 10.8 Gyr).
predictions: At f = 1.766 Hz the model coordinate is approximately 0.61155 Gyr (611.55 Myr).
falsification_conditions: A calculation using different declared reference values does not reproduce the stated model coordinate.

The proposed physical TF1766 frequency association is unsupported by the required observational or mechanistic evidence; such failure leaves the model mapping unverified rather than changing established frequency physics.
confusion_guard: Do not equate 0.56625 s with 611.55 Myr. The first is the physical period 1/f; the second is a separate model coordinate.
